title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #13

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. If you break a friend's ruler, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Say nothing
   C. Blame another
   D. Say sorry and offer to replace it

2. What should you do with a borrowed book? (1 mark)
   A. Return it in good condition
   B. Damage it
   C. Sell it
   D. Keep it

3. How did the crowd react? (1 mark)
   A. They were filled with awe and praised God
   B. They left in anger
   C. They argued
   D. They laughed

4. Which of these shows God's love? (1 mark)
   A. He punishes for no reason
   B. He hides from people
   C. He ignores prayers
   D. He gave us Jesus to save us

5. Which Old Testament chapter tells the sad story of Tamar? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12
   B. Exodus 20
   C. Psalm 23
   D. 2 Samuel 13

6. Which is a good first step when you are angry with someone? (1 mark)
   A. Plan revenge
   B. Calm down and breathe
   C. Shout at the person
   D. Break their things

7. Why did people dislike tax collectors? (1 mark)
   A. They were poor
   B. They were farmers
   C. They were teachers
   D. Many took more money than they should

8. Why is knowing your full name important for your safety? (1 mark)
   A. You can use it to tease others
   B. You can hide it from your parents
   C. You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   D. You can forget your family

9. Who shared five loaves and two fish in John 6? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. A king
   C. A soldier
   D. A boy

10. What does persecution mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being treated badly because of what you believe
   B. Being praised
   C. Being taught
   D. Being paid

11. Which is a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Litter
   B. Skip lessons
   C. Fight freely
   D. Arrive on time

12. Which quality of Mary should we copy? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Pride
   C. Anger
   D. Trust in God and humility

13. Which disciple betrayed Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. Judas Iscariot
   C. Andrew
   D. Peter

14. What does a person do when they repent, causing joy in heaven? (1 mark)
   A. To hide sin
   B. To blame others
   C. They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   D. To ignore sin

15. What does "hallowed" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Holy
   B. Old
   C. Loud
   D. Rich

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three reasons why we should read the Bible. (3 marks)

17. Explain the steps a child can take to turn away from wrong behaviour, using Zacchaeus as an example. (5 marks)

18. State three results of telling lies. (3 marks)

19. State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation. (2 marks)

20. Explain what "born again" means. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Say sorry and offer to replace it
   Honesty and repair are responsible.

2. A — Return it in good condition
   Borrowed items must be returned.

3. A — They were filled with awe and praised God
   They said, "A great prophet has appeared."

4. D — He gave us Jesus to save us
   John 3:16 shows God's love in giving His Son.

5. D — 2 Samuel 13
   The story of Tamar is in 2 Samuel 13.

6. B — Calm down and breathe
   Calming down helps you to choose wisely.

7. D — Many took more money than they should
   Many tax collectors cheated people.

8. C — You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   A name helps people identify you and help you find your family.

9. D — A boy
   A boy's lunch was used to feed a large crowd.

10. A — Being treated badly because of what you believe
   Persecution is unfair treatment for faith.

11. D — Arrive on time
   Being on time is a common school rule.

12. D — Trust in God and humility
   Mary trusted God and called herself the Lord's servant.

13. B — Judas Iscariot
   Judas betrayed Jesus.

14. C — They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repenting means turning back to God.

15. A — Holy
   Hallowed be your name means may your name be honoured as holy.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Admit the wrong; be sorry and tell God; say sorry to the person hurt; put things right as Zacchaeus repaid; decide not to repeat and ask God for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, and a clear link to Zacchaeus.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.
